description: The closing date for submission of the Phase 1 whitepaper for CTT CSO Increment 1 AoI has been extended from 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 6, 2026 to 1:00 P.M. EDT on April 8, 2026. Please see attachment titled "CTT Increment 1 AOI_Revision1" posted to the CSO for the extended closing date highlighted in yellow.
